claims.public_claim: A GEO-Pulse production backfill preview indexed 18,335 evidence candidates and explicitly identified 6,073 missing artifacts.
claims.metric_name: evidence candidates and explicit missing artifacts
claims.method: Idempotent preview indexed operational evidence identities and marked absent artifacts as missing without moving source data.
claims.scope_and_limitations: This is an internal evidence-lineage operation, not a count of audited businesses and not a customer outcome metric.
claims.privacy_treatment: aggregate counts only; redact source records, tenants, domains, IDs, and excerpts
claims.allowed_public_wording: Good intelligence tracks what is missing, not only what succeeded. In one production preview, GEO-Pulse explicitly marked 6,073 absent artifacts instead of treating them as empty success.
claims.prohibited_inference: Do not present evidence records as audited sites, market coverage, benchmark authority, or customer results.
